title: Implicit L1 for nonlinear laws: Newton's iteration without a test of the result and safeguarded solver, uniform and graded meshes, N in {16, 64, 256, 1024}
note: Newton: iteration started from the previous iterate, for FENE-P with a step halved as long as the new iterate would have tr C >= b, no admissibility test of the result (fracsp.spd.solve_l1_newton). Safeguarded: the same iteration, accepted only if it converged to an admissible tensor, otherwise the admissible solution of the step from the scalar equation (FENE-P) or the Riccati equation (Giesekus) (fracsp.spd.solve_l1). Inadmissible: smallest eigenvalue <= 0, or tr C >= b for FENE-P. Step bound of the linear law: Gamma(2 - alpha) (h_n / lambda)^alpha (2 Wi s - 1) < 1 with s the spectral abscissa of the unit-rate velocity gradient.
columns: runs above the step bound of the linear law
Newton: smallest eigenvalue over converged runs
Newton: largest trace over converged runs
safeguarded: runs that used the root solver
